themes.title: Electronic health record integration
themes.why: Agents in healthcare work inside the patient record. What the research says about each platform's EHR path.

rows.text: Connect Health provides a direct current Epic path for healthcare workflows.
Healthcare buyer uses Epic and wants agentic/patient-service workflows on AWS.
Five9 provides a browser-based agent/supervisor experience and can embed into major CRMs; Fusion extends voice, digital and AI workflows into systems such as ServiceNow and Epic.
Five9 has first-party or formal integrations with major systems of record including Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft, Oracle, Zendesk and Epic, plus UC integrations with Teams and Zoom.
Runtime support ownership is straightforward for Five9-native functions but becomes shared across Five9, CRM/EHR/UC vendors, ISVs and SIs in embedded/Fusion/custom architectures.
Implementation Gravity is MODERATE for a bounded standard deployment and rises to HIGH for global telephony, multi-system migration, WEM, CRM/EHR embedding, custom APIs and AI automation.
Discovery must resolve telephony/countries, digital channels, outbound compliance, WEM variant, CRM/EHR architecture, data migration, AI authority and operating ownership before configuration.

A production cutover should test routing, outbound pacing/compliance, telephony, digital, CRM/EHR, WEM, AI and data offload under failure; public Five9 methodology supports controlled deployment but does not replace buyer-specific UAT.
Transformation TCO is driven by discovery, migration, telephony/number porting, CRM/EHR integration, WEM deployment, data offload, AI workflow design, UAT and change management.
Salesforce, ServiceNow or Epic is central to the agent workflow and the buyer wants contact-center functions embedded into that work surface.
Salesforce, ServiceNow or Epic is a major system of work.
Fusion partner program / Fusion for ServiceNow / Fusion for Epic: CRM/EHR-centric enterprise service operations
Native Epic integration is current as of April 2026.

themes.title: HIPAA and business associate agreements
themes.why: Protected health information needs HIPAA controls and a signed BAA for the exact service you buy.

rows.text: 8x8 publicly positions HIPAA, ISO 27001, FISMA, GDPR, PCI DSS and SOC 2 Type II controls/certifications across its platform materials.

Security posture includes SOC 2 Type II, TLS/AES encryption, GDPR practices, BAA availability for HIPAA use cases, role controls and limited-availability SAML; enterprise identity depth has documented limitations such as no IdP-initiated SSO and no SAML device-posture checks.

Avaya documents ISO 27001/27017/27018 scope for Infinity with Media Processing Core, HIPAA BAA support and PCI controls for Infinity. FedRAMP/IL4 applies to the separate Avaya Government Cloud service and must not be inherited into standard Infinity.

Bright Pattern publicly states compliance with SOC 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, TCPA and ISO 27001 and documents encryption, access controls and tenant/system audit records. Exact report scope, hosting model and certification applicability should be verified for the contracted deployment.
Dialpad documents ISO 27001/27017/27018, GDPR support, HIPAA-ready/BAA options, OAuth-based integration controls, configurable retention and customer AI-training choices.

Five9 publishes a mature security/compliance posture including SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001/27017, PCI DSS and HIPAA controls, but FedRAMP Moderate remains a future objective rather than a current federal authorization.
RingCX has current ISO 27001/27017/27018, C5, PCI, SOC 2+ FINRA/HIPAA and SOC 3 evidence on RingCentral's compliance site.

UJET documents privacy-by-design architecture and current certifications including PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC 1/2/3 and ISO 27001/27017/27018. Data-minimization and CRM-first design reduce duplicate PII storage, but processing/retention exceptions and service-provider paths still require workload-level review.

Vonage Contact Center currently publishes ISO 27001, PCI DSS, HIPAA and SOC 2 Type II security/compliance positioning, Salesforce Shield support and PCI Pal integration. Exact certification scope, BAA/service configuration and workload applicability must be validated for the contracted VCC product and region.
Vonage Contact Center's current public security page states ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS and SOC 2 Type II positioning, with Salesforce Shield support.

themes.title: Government authorization
themes.rule: names FedRAMP, StateRAMP, an impact level or a government environment
themes.why: An authorization belongs to one service boundary. What the research found authorized, where, and where it was not established.

rows.text: Avaya documents ISO 27001/27017/27018 scope for Infinity with Media Processing Core, HIPAA BAA support and PCI controls for Infinity. FedRAMP/IL4 applies to the separate Avaya Government Cloud service and must not be inherited into standard Infinity.
Government authorization is service-bound.
Avaya Government Cloud: U.S. public sector / DoW regulated communications
Webex Contact Center Enterprise is FedRAMP authorized; public evidence reviewed does not establish that the primary multi-tenant Webex Contact Center service inherits that exact authorization.
storm has broad current enterprise compliance credentials including FedRAMP High.
Buyer requires current FedRAMP authorization for the Five9 CCaaS environment.

Five9 operates globally using distributed data centers and public-cloud deployments, but exact data-residency and sovereign deployment options are region/product specific; federal FedRAMP authorization is not yet obtained as of validation.

Five9 publishes a mature security/compliance posture including SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001/27017, PCI DSS and HIPAA controls, but FedRAMP Moderate remains a future objective rather than a current federal authorization.

Five9 fit rises materially for blended inbound/outbound, BPO, CRM-centric and pragmatic enterprise modernization, and falls for tiny deployments, current federal FedRAMP requirements, sovereignty-led procurements or buyers needing the broadest bespoke enterprise process orchestration.
FedRAMP or a specific sovereign deployment is mandatory.
The procurement requires current FedRAMP authorization for the contracted CCaaS service and no approved alternative architecture exists.
Current FedRAMP authorization is mandatory.

Current public RingCX evidence reviewed for this package does not establish a FedRAMP authorization for RingCX; federal buyers must require exact-service authorization evidence rather than infer status from RingCentral or partner products.
Talkdesk operates regional cloud infrastructure in independent US, Canada and EU AWS regions and maintains a separate FedRAMP region/edition.
Talkdesk maintains a broad security/compliance certification portfolio and CX Cloud Government Edition achieved FedRAMP authorization in 2025.

Zoom for Government is a separate environment from commercial Zoom and includes a FedRAMP Moderate-authorized Zoom Contact Center service boundary; commercial and government capabilities/authorizations must not be silently inherited across environments.
Zoom for Government Contact Center is FedRAMP Moderate authorized in a separate government environment.

Evidence confidence is high for current architecture, channels, WFM/QM, APIs, divisions, government authorization and 2026 AI releases; it is lower for buyer-specific capacity, full exitability, strict AI model locality and commercial true-down/usage economics.
Eliminate the proposed service boundary if required jurisdictional processing or government authorization cannot be proven for the exact ordered environment.
Government buyer can use the separate Zoom for Government service boundary and its supported ZCC scope.

themes.title: Collections and outbound
themes.why: Collections run on outbound dialing under consent and contact rules. What each platform offers and where it breaks.

rows.text: Best fit is enterprise and upper-midmarket operations with material outbound, collections, compliance, WEM or existing Aspect/Noble/Alvaria estates. Greenfield buyers seeking the cleanest broad modern CCaaS control plane should explicitly compare the mixed portfolio/control-plane burden.
Collections / financial recovery / compliance-heavy outreach

Dialpad Dialer provides progressive campaigns, DNC/attempt controls, voicemail detection, analytics/export/API and can support service or collections, but Dialer users require Dialpad Sell Premium plus outbound calling credits.
Dialpad Dialer can run outbound service or collections campaigns from Contact Center, but Dialer users require Dialpad Sell Premium licenses and outbound calling credits.
Dialpad Dialer: Outbound sales/service/collections
Buyer needs predictive/power/blended high-volume outbound, collections or tightly governed campaign operations.
rows.detail: Advanced outbound can cross CxEngage, AutoReach and other Enghouse product/add-on boundaries rather than behaving as one universal native dialer.

rows.text: Blended inbound/outbound, collections, sales or proactive service is strategically important.

themes.title: Order and booking actions by AI agents
themes.why: Self-service that acts on orders and appointments, and what the research could not yet establish about it.

rows.text: AI/MCP is allowed to change customer, payment, booking, order, case or regulated system-of-record state without bounded authority.
rows.detail: Agentic AI action capability can outrun transaction-integrity controls if identity, confirmation, idempotency, partial-failure recovery and audit are not proven for each connected system.

rows.text: Dialpad Agentic AI Agents can execute configured actions such as booking appointments, checking order status, updating records and creating tickets, with instructions/guardrails and connectors. Public evidence does not fully establish idempotency, rollback/compensation, action-by-action audit depth or mandatory human confirmation for every transaction.
